Based on the visual inspection of the time series plot, there is a distinct anomaly where the values spike significantly higher than the rest of the data. This occurs towards the right side of the graph.

1.  **Identify the start of the anomaly:** The sharp increase begins just before the x-axis tick mark for 600. Looking closely, it starts around index **590**.
2.  **Identify the end of the anomaly:** The high values persist until shortly after the 600 mark, dropping back down to the normal range (around 4-5 mm) at approximately index **610**.

Therefore, the detected range of anomalies is:

[[590, 610]]
